About MITS
History
Madhav Institute of Technology & Science (MITS), Gwalior was established in 1957 by His Highness Sir Jiwaji Rao Scindia, Maharaja, of the erstwhile state of Gwalior under open door policy of Govt. of India. The foundation stone of the institute was laid by the then President Dr. Rajendra Prasad, on 28th October, 1956 and the building was inaugurated by President Dr. S. Radhakrishnan on 11th December, 1964. On the occasion of Golden Jubilee Celebrations of the institute, the president of India, Dr. Pratibha Devi Singh Patil graced the Golden Jubilee Celebrations of the institute as Chief Guest on 30th June, 2008. A postal stamp on MITS was also released on this occasion.

Autonomy & Accreditation
The institute is declared Deemed to be University under Distinct Category by Ministry of Education, Government of India in the year 2024. The institute is accredited by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) with A++ Grade (CGPA 3.53) for 5 years from 2023. Many of the programmes are accredited by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA).

Quality Culture
An Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) was established in December 2016 to evolve mechanism and procedures for measuring, monitoring and evaluating quality for various academic and administrative activities of the institution, for the internalization of quality culture and institutionalization of best practices.

TEQIP Funding
The institute successfully completed the Technical Education Quality Improvement programme (TEQIP-Phase II) of MHRD and received ‘A’ grade in six of the seven performance criterions. Further, the institute is now on board TEQIP-III.

MOODLE Server
The institute started its own MOODLE Server (Modular Object-Oriented Dynamic Learning Environment) on 15th august 2017 for open source course management system to facilitate E-learning, Evaluation, Test / Quiz Conduction, Uploading Assignments etc.

Campus, Courses & Centres
The institute has a lush green environment conscious campus of around 44.6 acres which also includes ‘Madhav-Van’ a small teak wood forest where a large variety of birds can be sighted. The Institute offers 19 Bachelors, 11 Masters and Doctoral Degrees Programmes in Engineering and Technology. The Institute is a recognized Quality Improvement Programme (QIP) Centre for PG and Ph.D programs. The prime objective of the institute is to provide quality technical education at undergraduate and postgraduate levels.There is Study Centre of Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU) and Nodal centre of RGPV, Bhopal.

Local Centre of NPTEL
NPTEL(National Programme on Technology Enhanced Learning) Local Chapter has been established on 30th Oct 2017 to provide e-learning through on-line Web and Video courses in Engineering, Sciences, Technology among students.

Infrastructure
The Institute has state-of-the-art infrastructure encompassing spacious class rooms equipped with power point projectors, well equipped laboratories, three boys hostels, two girls hostels, Play ground, Gymnasium, Dispensary, Bank, ATM, Stationary & Photocopy shop, Canteen, Amul Parlour, Coffee Shop etc.

Central Library currently houses over 1,00,000 books, e-journals from Science Direct, ASME and ASCE under E-Shodh Sindhu & INFLIBNET consortium. The Institute has a high speed LAN with backbone of optical fiber and manageable switches. The institute is equipped with 1000 MBPS leased line from BSNL, which is providing high speed 24x7 internet facility in each nook and corner of the Institute.

Entrepreneurship Development Cell
The institute has DST established Entrepreneurship Development Cell, since 1988. The cell is active throughout the year and conducts various job oriented/innovative certificate courses, Faculty Development Programmes, Entrepreneurship Awareness Camps, Conferences and other activities.

Professional Society Chapters & Club Activities
To harness the immense potential and vivacious energy of the students for their all round personality development and confidence building, the institute provided a very active NSS and NCC wing, 07 Chapters of National/International Professional Societies (ISTE, IEEE, IET, ACM,CSI,IETE and SAE-INDIA) & 60 different institute level student clubs in wide areas ranging from technology, art, music, dance, meditation, yoga, health, sports, environment, social awareness etc.

Sports Facilities
The institute has cricket, basketball, football and tennis grounds, and badminton court along with facilities for indoor games. The institute has been successively receiving awards and top ranks in many sporting events such as Table-Tennis, Badminton, and Basket-ball at the nodal and state level. Prizes are also won in Kho-Kho, chess and football.

## Vision & Mission
Vision & Mission

Vision
To create world class quality Engineers and Technocrats capable of providing leadership in all spheres of life and society

Mission
To provide quality education in technical and allied disciplines.
To organize and arrange innovative courses in Engineering and Technology.
To arrange vocational courses in the upcoming fields and innovative subjects to meet global advancement.
To promote research in the fields of Technology and Science.

## Vice Chancellor Message
Vice Chancellor's Message

Vice Chancellor
Dr. Rajindra Kumar Pandit

From the Vice Chancellor’s Desk………
Dear Students, Parents, Alumni, and Corporate Partners,

It brings me immense joy to share that Madhav Institute of Technology and Science (MITS), Gwalior, has successfully completed two years as a Deemed-to-be-University. In March 2024, the Ministry of Education, Government of India, on the advice of the UGC, granted us this prestigious status. Since our inception in 1957, MITS has proudly served the nation. Today, this milestone allows us to leverage academic autonomy to scale new heights of excellence for all our stakeholders.

To Our Students and Parents: A Holistic Ecosystem
We are committed to nurturing well-rounded individuals through a dynamic curriculum that implements the National Education Policy (NEP-2020) in letter and spirit. We offer undergraduate programs across 19 disciplines, alongside cutting-edge B.Tech and newly launched Post-Graduate programs in emerging areas like Artificial Intelligence, Embedded Systems & VLSI, and the Internet of Things (IoT).
Our unique continuous evaluation model, relative grading, summer semesters, and credit transfers from MOOCs (NPTEL) encourage self-learning. Furthermore, our mandatory courses in Python, Data Science, and Machine Learning—paired with minor degree options—ensure that every student, regardless of their core branch, can thrive in an interdisciplinary world. Beyond academics, our vibrant, green campus and active student clubs ensure personal growth, leadership development, and options to develop excellent communication skills.

To Our Corporate Partners: Industry-Ready Professionals
MITS is dedicated to producing engineers who can solve real-world challenges from day one. Our student-centric roadmap includes a dedicated credit course on Professional Skills and Competencies in the pre-final year. This is capped by a mandatory, full-time final-semester internship that provides students with practical corporate exposure before graduation.
Our students learn by doing. Equipped with state-of-the-art labs in Robotics, ML, AR/VR, and IoT, they actively transition from learners to innovators. This is proven by their consistent victories at premier global hackathons and their ability to build in-house digital portals that streamline our university operations, saving significant revenue and man-hours.

To Our Global Alumni Network: A Legacy of Excellence
Our alumni are our greatest pride. You occupy highly placed, influential positions across global corporates, public sectors, railways, armed forces, administrative services, and academia. As MITS transitions into this distinct university era, your legacy remains our anchor. We are expanding our Ph.D. programs in thrust areas and funding high-productivity research to ensure your alma mater remains a globally recognized hub of innovation.

Looking Ahead
The Deemed-to-be-University status has allowed us to elevate our quality initiatives, fulfilling the national mandate of providing a holistic technical education that strengthens India's global footprint. On behalf of the management, faculty, and staff, I welcome our current and prospective students, and I wish you all the very best in your present and future endeavours.

# Campus Infrastructure & Facilities

## Learning Resource Centre (Central Library)
Student Life — Facilities
Learning Resource Centre (Central Library)
Madhav Institute of Technology & Science (MITS), Gwalior

Overview:
Welcome to the Central Library, Madhav Institute of Technology & Science — a very special place on the MITS campus with its rich collection of books and journals in the field of Engineering and Architecture related disciplines. The Central Library currently houses around 1,00,000 books, comprising textbooks and reference books for Engineering Graduates (UG), Postgraduates (PG), and Ph.D. curriculum in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science & Information Technology, and Architecture disciplines. The library collection also includes documents in Computer Science, History of Science, Fiction, Stories, General books, Encyclopaedias, Dictionaries, and Magazines.

Digital Library & RFID Automation:
The Central Library recently automated its library services; in the Gwalior region, MITS Central Library is the first to implement RFID technology with international security standards (ISO-15693 / ISO 18000-3), operating on 13.56 MHz. In the last 12 months, more than 38,651 books were issued to various UG/PG students. It is an effective automated system used worldwide for managing library collections and providing enhanced services to users, offering benefits such as:
- Theft control and misplaced reading material tracking
- Sorting, inventory accuracy, and stock verification procedures
- Security control, video surveillance, and Smart Card integration
All books are tagged with the latest RFID technology. For issuing books, students present their Smart Card at the circulation counter. Upon transaction completion, students receive issue/return status via SMS on their mobile or can check transaction status on their individual dashboard under the "My Books Issued Status" tab.

Archive Section:
The Library maintains an archive section of rare and vintage books dating back to 1950. This valuable collection caters to the needs of research scholars. The library also houses a rich collection of over 1,000 M.Tech Dissertations and Ph.D. theses.

Key Services:
- Circulation: Weekly branch-wise issue and return facility so all students can avail the collection.
- Open Access System: Facilitates students to search and browse required material directly on the shelves.
- Reprographic Services: Photocopy services provided on demand.
- Computer Lab: Dedicated computer lab with 15 computers inside the library for accessing E-books, E-journals, and online resources. High-speed Wi-Fi is available in and around the library.
- E-Journals: Subscribes to international e-journal databases covering 620+ titles across engineering disciplines: (a) IEEE (b) ASME (c) ASCE (d) ScienceDirect. Central Library also subscribes to print national and international journals. E-journals are accessible 24/7 across the campus via a dedicated leased line.

Library Timings:
- Working Hours: 10:00 AM to 8:30 PM on all working days.

Integrated Library Management System (ILMS):
- Software: Koha (Version: 3.18)
- Nature of Automation: Fully Automated (Automated in 2014 with RFID & Institute ERP integration; Koha adopted in 2016)
- Features: Web-based ILS with MariaDB/MySQL back end, MARC cataloguing, Z39.50/SRU support, Web 2.0 (tagging, RSS, comments), union catalogue, online circulation, barcode/RFID, and member card printing.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Q1: What is the admission process for B.Tech at MITS Gwalior?
A: B.Tech admissions at MITS are conducted primarily through JEE Main scores and Madhya Pradesh state online counselling conducted by Directorate of Technical Education (DTE MP). Key steps include:
   1. Appear in the JEE Main examination.
   2. Register for MP DTE online counselling at https://dte.mponline.gov.in.
   3. Fill branch and institute choices (select MITS Gwalior and preferred branches).
   4. Attend document verification and receive seat allotment.
   5. Report to MITS, submit required documents, and pay the admission fee.

Q2: What is the admission process for B.Arch?
A: Admissions to Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch) are based on NATA scores and/or JEE Main Paper 2 scores through DTE MP online counselling.

Q3: What are the admission criteria for PG programs (M.Tech, MCA, MBA)?
A:
- M.Tech / M.E.: Based on GATE scores and qualifying degree marks through DTE MP counselling.
- MCA: Based on MP Pre-MCA test or qualifying graduation merit through DTE MP.
- MBA: Based on CMAT / qualifying graduation scores through DTE MP counselling.

Q4: What documents are required at the time of admission?
A: Candidates must bring original and photocopies of:
   - 10th and 12th Marksheets & Passing Certificates
   - Entrance Exam Score Card (JEE Main / GATE / NATA / CMAT / Pre-MCA)
   - MP DTE Seat Allotment Letter
   - Transfer Certificate (TC) & Migration Certificate
   - Character Certificate
   - Caste Certificate, Income Certificate & Domicile Certificate (if applicable)
   - Aadhaar Card & Passport size photographs
   - Medical fitness certificate
   Detailed list: https://web.mitsgwalior.in/images/2026/july/Admission%20documents_compressed.pdf

Q5: What scholarships are available for students at MITS?
A:
- SC/ST/OBC Post-Matric Scholarships via the MPTAASC portal.
- Mukhyamantri Medhavi Vidyarthi Yojana (MMVY) by the Government of MP (refer to https://scholarship.mitsgwalior.in).
- Gaon Ki Beti Yojana for eligible female students from rural areas.
- Pragati & Saksham Scholarships by AICTE.
- Merit scholarships and tuition fee waivers under the TFW (Tuition Fee Waiver) Scheme.

Q6: Is hostel accommodation available for first-year students?
A: Yes, hostel facilities are available for both boys and girls with 24x7 security, mess, Wi-Fi, recreation hall, and sports facilities. Hostel registration can be done via Google Form: https://forms.gle/b7Wm3Zjv8i2KDUHv7.

# Department of Civil Engineering

Department Vision
To develop civil engineers of global standards with leadership skills to serve society.

Department Mission
To foster academic development by offering state-of-the-art technical education at U.G. and P.G. levels through advanced teaching learning methodologies and facilities.
To impart skills to the students for keeping pace with the advances in techniques and technologies.
To promote research activities in various fields of civil engineering and inter disciplinary areas.
To provide solutions in various domains of civil engineering for societal development.

Civil Engineering is an NBA-accredited program
Department of Civil engineering is one of the pioneer department of the Institute, which commenced with the Inception of the Institute. At present department is offering B.Tech degree in Civil Engineering (4 year) and two post graduate courses i.e. M.E (Construction Technology & Management) and M.Tech (Structural Design) and Ph.D. Department has a quality improvement center for QIP programme which is under mentorship of IIT's. Department is well equipped with state of art instruments procured using various funding agencies including TEQIP II & III, AICTE grant and funds from various other agencies. To provide industrial exposure, the department is having MOU with CRRI (New Delhi), CBRI, NHAI & Gwalior smart city corporation limited. Department organizes regular field industrial visit to UG & PG students to provide them industrial exposure. Department regularly organizes seminars, workshops, STTP, expert lecture for knowledge and upgradation of skill of the students. For value addition of the students, department regularly conducts finishing school, remedial measures, novel engaging courses etc. Students are actively involved in Indian Concrete Institute (ICI) and Indian water works association (IWWA) activities. Department is leading resource center for providing consultancy services to various organizations. Leading academician, industrialist and students are involved in updating syllabus of the subjects through Board of studies and make course material relevant to present day requirement. Department is actively involved in research and development work for the benefits of students and society. Course curriculum of the B.Tech program is framed and designed as per National Education Policy, 2020.

B.Tech in Civil Engineering is Accredited by National Board of Accreditation (NBA) for 06 Years wef July 2021.

Department Vision
-----------------
To produce competent IT professionals, promote technological innovation and connecting multidimensional aspects of IT for societal growth and development.

Department Mission
------------------
- To ensure high quality education based on practical approach and industrial demand.
- To facilitate emerging courses, training programs and workshops in the field of Information Technology and interdisciplinary areas.
- To promote research and development in the domain of Information Technology to meet the emerging needs of the Society.
- To promote technological innovation and entrepreneurship in the areas of IT with interdisciplinary connect.

About the Department
--------------------
The Department of IT has an excellent & rich history and an outstanding record of contributions to the profession and community. The department is well recognized for excellence in facilities and teaching. The Department offers B.Tech. & M.Tech. programme in Information Technology and research program leading to PhD degree in Information Technology. 

The Department has a comprehensive curriculum on topics related to all aspects of Computer Hardware and Software with an emphasis on practical learning. The course structure is up-to-date and includes courses on emerging topics to equip our students with the latest developments in Information Technology. 

The Department has state-of-the-art infrastructure and computing equipment supported by high speed Ethernet and wireless networks. Our faculty members aim at delivering top-class education blending their rich research experience with classroom teaching. The Department has started a new ACM Chapter and signed an MoU with Infosys under Infosys Campus Connect Program.

## Laboratories
Laboratories — Department of Information Technology (IT)
==========================================================

1. Data Science Lab
   - Description: Data Science Lab provides a computing platform for novel languages like Python and R for building a coherent set of ideas, fundamentals of Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Deep Learning models and algorithms, and it facilitates students to practice basic programming in C, C++, and JAVA. Each lab session is aimed to translate theory lectures into practical implementation through programming paradigms, tools, and platforms provided in the data science lab.

2. Programming Lab
   - Description: Programming Lab welcomes students, researchers, interns, faculties, newbies, and everyone from a broad range of disciplines who are fascinated with the possibilities of turning big and complex data into knowledge. Members of the lab seek cutting-edge problem-based solutions to data mining, computer vision, and machine learning problems arising in numerous application areas involving data analytics.

3. Computing Lab
   - Description: The Computing Lab brings together researchers interested in developing fast, reliable, and robust numerical algorithms needed for modeling and simulation in a variety of fields including database management, numerical linear algebra, optimization, etc. The requirement of modern days is to have an automated system that manages, modifies, and updates data accurately. The lab aims at practicing and achieving this by using various software through hands-on training in programming and practical projects.

4. Project Lab
   - Description: Project Lab intends to deliver practical exposure towards mathematical background in linear algebra, analysis, probability, and optimization to develop the knowledge of machine learning to gain a deeper understanding of models and tools of great practical impact. It provides hands-on training in programming through practical projects. The goal is to enable students to independently apply the learned skills to real-world models and complex topics.

5. Hardware and Microprocessor Lab
   - Description: The microprocessor is a multipurpose, programmable device that accepts digital data as input, processes it according to instructions stored in its memory, and provides results as output. The objective of the Microprocessor and Microcontroller Laboratory is to familiarize students with 8086 Microprocessor & 8051 Microcontroller assembly language programming and interfacing with various modules. It helps students to implement industrial and real-time applications by understanding core concepts of microprocessors and microcontrollers.
